verdict.rationale: A community post says Martin now has a desktop app that a user keeps open beside VS Code. That gives thin, direct evidence of a desktop app, but no first-party docs describe it. The documented 'custom shortcuts' trigger multi-step assistant actions and are not shown to be OS-level hotkeys, and nothing shows screen access. Missing for 10: official desktop-app documentation, OS-level global shortcuts, screen-content access, independent hands-on corroboration of these features.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: oh, martin desktop is finally here! I use Martin to manage my todo list while i'm coding (on an hourly basis) - having it aside VSC is so handy!
